executiveSummary: OT-facing risk is elevated this period due to confirmed manipulation of refrigeration control systems across Europe, including an attempted setpoint change to 110°C at France's national blood service, and concurrent active exploitation of widely deployed remote access gateways (NetScaler ADC/Gateway and Ivanti Connect Secure). Combined with ongoing DoS against Cisco ASA/FTD and mass exploitation of Oracle PeopleSoft by ShinyHunters, the likelihood of IT-to-OT pivot attempts remains high for the next 72 hours. Immediate hardening of OT remote access paths, rapid patching of perimeter appliances, and enforced segmentation are strongly advised. Cold-chain attacks: Supermarkets in multiple countries and France's EFS blood service reported malicious temperature setpoint manipulation; swift response prevented losses, but targeting confirms OT risk. View Article Supporting Report Supporting Report NetScaler ADC/Gateway unauthenticated RCE is being actively exploited; DTLS-enabled VPN vServers are at particular risk. Patch immediately and investigate for compromise. Security Advisory Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS) gateways show active exploitation of multiple vulnerabilities (RCE/policy bypass, privilege escalation, file upload). Urgent patching and compromise assessment are required. Security Advisory Cisco ASA/FTD DoS is under active attack; outages can sever IT/OT segmentation and remote operations. Validate HA and update per vendor guidance. Supporting Report Mass exploitation of Oracle PeopleSoft (CVE-2026-35273) with WAF-bypass by ShinyHunters impacted government and transportation; patch and normalize WAF inputs to defeat encoding evasions. View Article Critical PHP "PHP2Shell" RCE with public PoCs continues to drive initial-access attempts against public web apps; treat unpatched PHP tiers as high risk for pivots toward OT DMZs. Advisory

relevance: Direct OT impacts observed Malicious setpoint changes on refrigeration/BMS controllers (healthcare cold-chain and retail grocery) confirm adversary willingness to manipulate physical processes. View Article High-risk IT-to-OT pivots Compromise of perimeter access devices (NetScaler, Ivanti, Cisco ASA/FTD) threatens remote maintenance channels and ICS DMZs. Web RCE (PHP) and ERP exploitation (PeopleSoft) provide footholds for lateral movement toward OT networks. Reducing exposure Enforce strict zoning, jump hosts with MFA, and least-privilege RBAC on all paths from IT → OT. Remove direct internet exposure of controllers; prefer VPN with device certificates and signed configurations. Instrument OT for change monitoring (setpoints, schedules) and alarm on out-of-bounds writes.

descriptions: Exploit Public-Facing Application; External Remote Services; Valid Accounts (perimeter gateways and web apps)
Credential Access: Session hijacking/cookie theft (APT29 watering holes), LSASS dumping (enterprise intrusions)
Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell/WMI; Scheduled Tasks for persistence (enterprise ransomware tradecraft)
Defense Evasion: WAF bypass via URL-encoding (PeopleSoft), Secure Boot bypass (BlackX bootkit)
ICS domain: Unauthenticated Setpoint/Parameter Changes; Remote Services Abuse; Alarm Inhibition (refrigeration/BMS)

outlook72h: Expect continued probing of refrigeration/BMS footprints and opportunistic re-targeting of exposed controllers; expand monitoring and remove any residual public exposure. Additional NetScaler/ICS gateway compromise discoveries likely as defenders investigate; prioritize containment, credential rotation, and clean rebuilds where indicators are present. Waves of PHP RCE exploitation and web shell deployment will persist; triage internet-facing portals and enforce emergency WAF rulesets. Higher likelihood of firewall/service degradation events (ASA/FTD DoS) that could disrupt remote operations; pre-stage out-of-band access and failover tests.
